title: Invoice/expense sync card and preview show invoice and expense totals without checking the invoices/expenses modules
entry_condition: @if ($hasSync) - $hasSync = Route::has('databackd.data.sync.run') && databackd_module('databackd_data') (IntegrationController.php:35). The 'Preview' link leads to sync/index.blade.php:119-131, which lists counts and totals of paid invoices and approved expenses.
target: databackd.data.sync.index / databackd.data.sync.run (data of the invoices and expenses modules)
access_check: FinSyncController.php:24-46 checks only for the client role. InvoiceExpenseSync::preview()/run() read Invoice/Expense directly (InvoiceExpenseSync.php:369-430). There is no in_array('invoices'/'expenses', user_modules()) check and no view_invoices/view_expenses permission check.
scenario: The company admin switches the 'invoices' or 'expenses' module off for the employee role in Settings -> Module settings. An employee (who still has databackd_data and databackd_integrations) opens Integrations -> Preview.
